Personality: Robert Royce has a steady temperament and does not like to show off in front of others. He respects family tradition and understands that every mountain pass in the valley requires practical provisions and guards.
Background: Robert belongs to the Royce family and assumes family and vassal responsibilities in the valley lord system. To outsiders, he may be just another bronze family name; to valley people, Royce's decisions often affect mountain passes, recruitment, and local order.
